question.text: Post the Finance (No. 2) Act 2024 amendment (effective 1 October 2024), the STT rate on the SALE of futures in securities is:

explanation.text: The Logic: The Finance (No. 2) Act 2024 increased STT on sale of futures in securities from 0.0125% to 0.02%, payable by the seller, with effect from 1 October 2024. STT on sale of options in securities was correspondingly hiked from 0.0625% to 0.1%. The Trap: 0.0125% is the pre-October-2024 rate on futures sales. 0.1% is the new options rate, not the futures rate. 0.2% is the OFS-related rate for unlisted shares. Note: The increase from 0.0125% to 0.02% represents a 60% jump in the per-trade STT cost on futures sales, which materially raises the gross alpha required by high-turnover strategies.
